title: rtl-files.json — integrated compilation inputs
description: The stage owner lists RTL sources in global dependency order, with include search paths and simulation-only DPI sources. Paths are relative to the RTL stage root. Task delegation does not determine compilation order.

files.description: RTL sources under src/, in the order each tool must read them. The whole src/ tree is delivered; headers reached through includes need no separate entry.

incdirs.description: Include search directories, relative to the RTL stage root, in search order.

sim_only.description: Simulation-only C/C++ DPI sources under src/. Linked by the simulator; not passed to synthesis or lint.
